label: Cirrhosis / alcohol-related mortality
reliability_criteria: Canonical tier = WHO Mortality Database cause-of-death registrations as submitted by member states (civil registration, ICD-coded, "Chronic liver diseases and cirrhosis" = the OECD's cross-ICD CICDCIRR grouping), redistributed by the OECD Causes of Mortality dataflow over SDMX, 45 areas, 1960-2024, sex-split as published (2,385 both-sexes + 2,352 male + 2,352 female cells in the live slice), quality codes as-reported (45 'D' + 3 'B' cells). Witness tier = WHO Global Health Estimates age-standardized liver-cirrhosis rates via GHO (modeled, 180 countries x 3 sexes at the GHE's own single 2019 vintage — no multi-year GHE cirrhosis series exists on the API, the neighboring codes probed and recorded; the all-ages series kept and the 15+ variant dropped logged per the connector's Dim2 rule). Authenticity first per ADR-0008: collector as-reported beside model estimates, never blended.
license: Mixed, per source (see "sources"): OECD DF_COM = OECD Terms and Conditions, attribution required (content: WHO Mortality Database); GHO witness = CC-BY-3.0-IGO.
notes: THE TODD BENCHMARK PAIR PRINTS ITSELF: La Chute finale's calibration anchor — France vs Sweden, the cirrhosis rates that scale the Soviet alcoholism estimate — rides the canonical's own 1979 cells (FRA 29.0 vs SWE 12.2 both-sexes, FRA 15.5 male vs SWE 17.5 male: the French both-sexes rate 2.4x Sweden's while the male rates nearly match, the class-and-gender structure the book reads). The Fou et le Prolétaire quadripod prints too: FRA/USA/DEU/ITA 1979 = 29.0/13.2/24.4(1990 start)/34.7 — Italy's 50.0 male the live slice's own maximum. The Défaite de l'Occident's Russia 2000-2017 face lives on the WITNESS alone (RUS absent from this cause's collector slice — see sources: the coding story), the same coverage shape unemployment's Germany 1991-2008 has. THE HONEST LIMITS: 45 areas canonical (OECD+ — no RUS/UKR on this cause, most of Africa and Central Asia absent); France's historical series (the 19th-century La Chute finale / L'invention de la France boards) is BOOK data, territory curated; the witness window is 2000-2021 so pre-2000/post-2021 comparisons are canonical-only; the GHE 15+ variant (RUS 2019 male 42.1 — the indicator's own title face) is dropped logged, one ref away if the 15+ comparison is ever demanded. The OWID cirrhosis chart doors were probed (deaths-from-cirrhosis 404-class) — no additional machine door found beyond the GHE root the project already carries.
